# Fresh Mewa

> Buy roasted makhana online at Fresh Mewa. Explore crunchy fox nuts in Pudina, Salt & Pepper and Peri Peri flavours perfect for chai breaks, work and travel.

Fresh Mewa (bestfreshmewa.com) sells flavoured roasted makhana (fox nuts) online in India. Payment: Cash on Delivery.

## Products

- [Pudina Makhana](https://www.bestfreshmewa.com/shop/pudina-makhana): Cool. Herby. Refreshingly familiar.
- [Salt & Pepper Makhana](https://www.bestfreshmewa.com/shop/salt-pepper-makhana): Classic. Savoury. Always a good idea.
- [Peri Peri Makhana](https://www.bestfreshmewa.com/shop/peri-peri-makhana): Bold. Spicy. Made for a little kick.
